run_validate_data_module: run the ValidateData StopesModule to validate datasets by checking line count parity across source, target, and metadata files
schedule_async_validate: schedule the async validate function to validate a list of datasets and return train source, target, and language pair line count maps
create_validate_data_config: create a ValidateDataConfig dataclass with a list of Dataset objects to configure the validation module
review_validate_run_method: review the ValidateData run method that counts lines in source, target, and metadata files and returns line counts when they match
test_validate_method: test the ValidateData validate method that checks whether the output line count is not None to confirm dataset validity
